routes.sourceLabel: NUS UCI Service D1 route map, route updated as of 25 July 2022
routes.detail: Stop labels and ordering are manually transcribed from the official NUS UCI D1 route-map image. Planted coordinates use the NextBus codelab API research inventory and remain requires-permission planning data, not verified current boarding-point positions.

plantedStops.positionNote: NextBus codelab API research coordinate reused for route-label planting. Not a verified current NUS ISB boarding-point coordinate.
